excerpts.text: [Section 9.2.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-9.2.2) states that **PUT**, **DELETE**, and the safe request methods are idempotent.
### Which HTTP methods are idempotent in RFC 9110?
The full idempotent set is therefore GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT, and DELETE.

assessment.rationale: The source table row 42 shows PUT has safe=no, idempotent=yes per RFC 9110 §9.2.2. Row 43 confirms DELETE has safe=no, idempotent=yes.
